name: Continuum spells are mutually exclusive (#5021)
contract: Singularity Core 804438, Paradox Cannon 806203, Flux Emitter 804435 and Aether Compression 804436 all end their own Description[enUS] with the identical line 'Can only have 1 Continuum spell active at a time', but no spell_group row existed for any of them, so all four could be active together. The new group (id 1141, SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_FROM_SAME_CASTER) makes each new cast remove the caster's previous one. All four require CasterAuraSpell 804455 (Echo Fragment) to cast, so the fixture re-applies one stack before each cast rather than relying on any one cast's own generation/consumption. Fails before the fix (all three stay up at once), passes after.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Let Singularity Core's global cooldown pass
Singularity Core is removed by Paradox Cannon
Let Paradox Cannon's global cooldown pass
Paradox Cannon is removed by Flux Emitter
